blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY, Albay— Seven men were arrested for allegedly engaging in illegal mining in a mountainous area of Barangay Sto. Niño in Virac, Catanduanes, on Tuesday afternoon. Lt. Col. Niño Lope M. Briones, chief of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG) Bicol Regional Field Unit, told the Inquirer in a phone interview on Wednesday that the operation stemmed from a tip from a concerned citizen. The CIDG Catanduanes Provincial Field Unit, led by Maj. Joven Osurman, conducted the operation in coordination with other police units and Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) personnel in Catanduanes. READ: 7 arrested for […]...
